summary: MaintDestinationProfile manages the detailed destination profile for institutional placements, covering address, description, closures, typical staffing, requirements, documents, contacts, placement capacity, utilization, and history. The system orchestrates UI controls for each section, enforces role-based edit restrictions, and integrates navigation across multiple tabs and views. Business logic governs screen access, discipline filtering, document handling, validation routines, and exception handling. It supports print/reporting functionality for specific sections and incorporates workflow for copying placement capacity.
purpose: To maintain and display all relevant information for a placement destination, including address, description, closures, staffing, prerequisites, documents, contacts, and capacity management; provide business rules, workflows, and UI controls for data entry, editing, validation, and reporting based on user roles and context.

workflows.name: Destination Profile Section Navigation
steps: User selects tab (Profile, Requirements, Documents, Capacity, Contacts, History)
System sets ActiveView and context page
For profile tab: loads Address, Description, Closures, Typical Staffing views
For requirements/documents/contacts/capacity/history tabs: loads corresponding user control and binds data

workflows.name: Copy Placement Capacity Workflow
steps: User selects capacity type (Individual or Group)
User may copy placement capacity from another destination
On confirmation, system deletes any existing entries and copies selected capacity data
System updates and refreshes discipline and child controls

workflows.name: Print Reporting Workflow
steps: User clicks Print button on active tab
System generates and displays report HTML for selected section
Report is rendered differently for students and other users

business_rules: Tabs and controls are enabled or visible based on role and context (e.g., StudentMode, UsingAlternateDatabase).
Edit permissions determined by complex role and agency checks (e.g., PlacingUserInOwnAgency, CheckScreenAccess).
Capacity editing restricted to discipline filtering (single/all).
Exist flags update tab headers to indicate presence of data.
Contacts, closures, and staffing restricted for students and alt database users.
validations: Department and Unit Manager presence for contacts.
First Name, Last Name, and Department fields in contacts must be validated unless UnitManager is selected.
Phone and Fax numbers validated with configurable mask.
Requirement description required if 'Other' requirement code selected.
Document sub-discipline selection validated for inclusion.
Start/End date checks for placement capacity.
Confirmation dialogs for destructive actions (e.g., copy placement capacity, delete discipline capacity).
calculations: Placement Capacity calculation depends on selected discipline, type (Individual/Group), and copied entries.
Exist flags for UI updated based on presence of corresponding data in profile.
conditions: StudentMode and UsingAlternateDatabase disable/hide certain tabs and controls.
Alt database context disables editing and restricts visible sections.
Contacts and closures hidden for students and alt database users.
system_behavior: UI controls are dynamically enabled/disabled based on context and user roles.
Data binding occurs per active tab/view.
Print/reporting logic generates section-specific output for users.
Validation routines invoked on form submit or specific UI events.
Tabs and controls re-rendered upon navigation or async postbacks.
dependencies: DestinationProfiles for profile search and data retrieval
Service for destination services and contacts
Dropdown controls for discipline and capacity selection
UserSession context for permissions and agency checks
Resources for UI labels and prompts
exceptions: Invalid UUID or data binding errors handled by fallback logic.
UI exceptions handled via error panels and visible error list.
Copy Placement Capacity action warns and prevents when no entries are selected.
content_gaps: Some user control implementations (e.g., actual data validation, backend calls) are abstracted and not fully described.
No detailed structure of Service, Document, Requirement, or Contact entities provided.
Actual SQL queries for data retrieval are not included.
Exact UI layout and resource label values are not all specified.
